anti_collapse: Operational coordination history, routing currentness, conversational reply rules, identity referent, and session provenance are distinct predicates. One Vera identity does not imply shared session awareness; historical lane existence does not make a lane current; provider visibility does not prove read state.

Git append, guard success, provider projection, delivery, conflict, runtime routing and deployment remain separate effects. Red-team failures are historical facts at their tested cut, not claims of current vulnerability after later source changes.

Parallax topology registration, first guarded append, coordination activation, design proposal, source implementation and provider deployment are distinct event/effect classes. A merged design or onboarding PR does not prove runtime activation.

Repository schema/source changes are canonical project history but do not prove provider migrations, deployed runtime state, accepted assignments or completed external effects without separate readback.
